## Oshkosh Corporation Earns Two CES Innovation Awards® 2027 Honoree Distinctions for Advancements in Autonomy and Connected Technologies


11/09/26


- *Two CES 2027 Innovation Awards Honoree distinctions recognize Oshkosh Corporation technologies in the Construction & Industrial Tech and Supply & Logistics categories.*
- *Award-winning innovations include the JLG® Canvas RO2330, an autonomous drywall finishing robot and Oshkosh AeroTech™ GateBots, designed to automate airport ramp operations.*
- *Recognition builds momentum for CES 2027, where Oshkosh will showcase how AI, autonomy, connectivity and electrification are transforming essential industries and empowering everyday heroes.*


****


**OSHKOSH, Wis. (Nov. 09, 2026)** –Oshkosh Corporation (NYSE: OSK), a global industrial technology company that develops purpose-built vehicles, equipment and services, today announced that two of its advanced technologies have been named **CES Innovation Awards® 2027 Honorees by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA)®** . The recognitions highlight Oshkosh's continued leadership in applying autonomy and connected technologies to address real-world challenges across job sites and airports.


Oshkosh Corporation received CES Innovation Awards Honoree distinctions in the following categories:


- **Construction & Industrial Tech – JLG® Canvas RO2330** : An autonomous drywall finishing robot that performs repetitive mudding and sanding tasks. Featuring interchangeable robotic end-effectors, the technology enables one operator to manage multiple robots, extending workforce capabilities while supporting consistent finish quality. The innovation represents JLG's vision for intelligent job sites and a shift from enabling jobs to executing jobs, where purpose-built equipment can increasingly perform defined tasks autonomously.
- **Supply & Logistics – GateBots – Connected Airport:** Developed by Oshkosh AeroTech™, GateBots are autonomous robotic systems designed to support routine aircraft ramp activities, including aircraft guidance, wheel-chock placement and other ground operations. Working within the company's iOPS® intelligent operating ecosystem, these technologies help coordinate people, equipment and processes throughout the aircraft turnaround, supporting operational efficiency and worker safety.


"At Oshkosh, innovation begins with understanding the challenges facing the everyday heroes who keep our communities moving," said Jay Iyengar, executive vice president and chief technology and strategic sourcing officer, Oshkosh Corporation. "Whether it's enabling construction professionals to accomplish more through autonomous technology, or helping ground crews coordinate complex airport operations, we're applying AI, autonomy, connectivity and electrification to solve meaningful, real-world problems. These recognitions reinforce our commitment to developing safe, intuitive and productive products that make tough jobs easier."


The CES Innovation Awards program, owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA)®, is an annual competition recognizing outstanding design and engineering in consumer technology products. An elite panel of industry expert judges, including members of the media, designers, engineers and more, reviewed submissions.


Oshkosh will return to CES for the third consecutive year, January 6–9, 2027, in Las Vegas, **showcasing how AI, autonomy, connectivity and electrification are transforming essential industries** . From connected airports and intelligent job sites to the neighborhoods we serve, Oshkosh continues to advance purpose-built technologies that help everyday heroes tackle their toughest challenges. Both award-winning innovations, GateBots and the JLG® Canvas RO2330, **will be featured in live demonstrations at the Oshkosh booth (#4641, West Hall)** , bringing the company's latest advancements in autonomous technology to life.


To learn more about Oshkosh Corporation's advanced technologies, visit[oshkoshcorp.com](https://www.oshkoshcorp.com/) . **About Oshkosh Corporation**


At Oshkosh (NYSE: OSK), we design, develop and deliver purpose-built vehicles, equipment and services that help everyday heroes build, serve and protect communities around the world. Headquartered in Wisconsin, Oshkosh Corporation employs over 18,000 team members worldwide, all united behind a common purpose: to make a difference in people’s lives. Oshkosh products can be found in more than 150 countries under the brands of JLG®, Pierce®, MAXIMETAL, Oshkosh® S-Series™, McNeilus®, IMT®, Jerr-Dan®, Frontline™ Communications, Oshkosh® Airport Products, Oshkosh AeroTech™, Oshkosh® Defense and Pratt Miller. For more information, visit[oshkoshcorp.com](https://www.oshkoshcorp.com/) .


**About CES®**


CES is the most powerful tech event in the world – the proving ground for breakthrough technologies and global innovators. This is where the world's biggest brands do business and meet new partners, and the sharpest innovators hit the stage. Owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA)®, CES features every aspect of the tech sector. CES 2027 takes place Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas. Learn more at[CES.tech](https://www.ces.tech/) and follow CES on[social](https://x.com/CTATech) .


**About Consumer Technology Association (CTA)®**


As North America’s largest technology trade association, CTA is the tech sector. Our members are the world’s leading innovators – from startups to global brands – helping support more than 17 million American jobs. CTA owns and produces CES® – the most powerful tech event in the world. Find us at CTA.tech. Follow us @CTAtech.
